column2: Leads moving targets using weapon bullet speed and drop. Off = aim the bone only. Also skips prediction when you are not holding a gun.
Which body part the aimbot tracks. Randomized Part re-rolls every shot while holding Mouse 1.
Filters which targets aimbot will consider.
Adds light drift and overshoot so mouse aim feels less robotic.
How strong humanize drift and overshoot are.
Hold or toggle this key to activate aimbot.
Higher values move the camera slower toward the target.
How smoothing accelerates: Linear, Ease Out, Ease In-Out, Exponential, or Adaptive.
While your aim key is held, stays on the first target even if they leave FOV. Releases and forgets the target when you let go of the bind.
Choose whether aimbot targets players, NPCs, or both.
Clears the aim whitelist player list.
Comma-separated Roblox user IDs that Aimbot must ignore. Enable Whitelist inside Filters first. You can also middle-click the current player target to add or remove them.
Smooth camera aim assist on your current target. Bind a key on the chip (Always / Hold / Toggle).
Selects the announcer. More characters can be added through the character registry.
Minimum delay between non-urgent comments. Death, downed, drowning, and combat can interrupt.
How long each speech bubble remains visible.
Shows a draggable transparent anime announcer that reacts to local survival events. Draw-only: it creates no Roblox instances and writes nothing to Workspace.
Choose which read-only local state transitions can trigger dialogue: survival, combat status, nearby threats, and world events.
Changes character transparency. The speech bubble stays nearly opaque for readability.
Mixed alternates between teasing and supportive lines; Roasty and Supportive lock the tone.
Plays a random greeting so you can test appearance and dialogue.
Moves the announcer back to the lower-left corner.
Changes the waist-up character size.
Keeps the character visible between comments. Disable for event-only popups.
Prevents idle kick by simulating activity.
Spoofs your look direction to other players.
Makes other players' character parts non-collidable on your client. Their original collision values are restored when disabled.

Automatically turns and runs to selected resources, verifies the live weak point is visible and centered, then swings using the equipped compatible tool. Vector must be the foreground window because movement and clicks use OS input.
Draws a tracer to the exact TreeX or NodeSpark point plus the current state, distance, and held tool.
Select every resource type Autofarm may visit. Your held tool must support that type: axes for trees, pickaxes for nodes, or a compatible hybrid tool.
Maximum distance in studs used when searching for the next resource. Larger ranges cover more area but can produce longer direct routes.
Draws 3D boxes around visible base parts.
GPU mesh chams on selected base structures (in-range only).
Glow preset color (Fill Glow / Wireframe Glow only).
Fill, Wireframe, Fill Glow, or Wireframe Glow.
Highlights base parts like doors, turrets, and storage.
Shows distance on base ESP.
Shows names on base ESP.

Wireframe mesh chams on structural walls/floors/foundations (Detail meshes). ApplyChams only — no Material/Texture/Transparency writes, no new instances. Skips Base ESP targets (doors, boxes, turrets, cabinets).
Only structural pieces within this distance get wireframe chams.
Auto-jumps while you hold Space on the ground for smoother bunny hops.
Moves you to the peek with desync for server-valid shots. Can cause invalids or kicks.
Master toggle for advanced bullet routing (hitscan, bullet TP, silent manip). Bind Always / Hold / Toggle from the key chip.
Loads your named config automatically on inject.
Config name to load on start. Falls back to your old Autoload Slot if needed.
Deletes the selected config file from April_configs.
Loads the selected / named config from April_configs.
Name used when saving. Saved as April_configs\\Name.cfg when possible, otherwise April_Config_Name.cfg in Scripts. Old slot files are imported automatically.
Rescans saved configs and re-imports any old April_Slot files.
Saves current settings to April_configs as ConfigName.cfg.
Pick a saved/imported config. Selecting it fills Config Name.
Draws a custom crosshair on screen.
Moves the crosshair toward your active combat target.
Desyncs your network position from where you appear.
Hides inactive event rows from the event status panel.
Shows live timed crates, event NPCs, and bosses. BTR tracks the 13-minute loot-fire cooldown after destroy (raids use Raid ESP only).
Rapidly ducks your hitbox height.
Manual alternative to Autofarm. It redirects your held melee swings to the nearest compatible weak point, but you move and hold attack yourself.
Launches nearby entities upward.
Camera-relative HRP velocity fly (WASD + Space/Ctrl). Built-in duck (HipHeight 0.01) and jump state while airborne — does not toggle Fake Duck. Never changes WalkSpeed or JumpPower.
Disables collision on your key character parts while flying. Collision is restored when you land or turn Fly off.
Forces a 2-round burst on your held gun. Patches ToolInfo directly — does not use GC mults.
Boosts RPM via FireRateMult. Usually needs Muzzle Boost on the gun — without it the game often ignores fire-rate mults.
Extends max range via RangeMult. Silencer and Compensator reduce range; this patches whatever range mults exist on your gun.
Lowers recoil. Works on any gun — no attachment required.
Boosts bullet speed via SpeedMult on live weapon tables. Not an attachment stat — Swift Heavy Ammo also adds speed; equip a gun before enabling.
Tightens aim and hip spread. Sights (Holo, ACOG, scopes) also add spread mults that this stacks with.
Removes scope sway while aiming. Only affects guns with a scope or sight equipped.
Applies weapon stat changes globally to your held gun.
Shows an on-screen list of your keybinds.
Draws 3D boxes around visible loot.
GPU mesh chams on selected loot types (in-range only).
Glow preset color (Fill Glow / Wireframe Glow only).
Fill, Wireframe, Fill Glow, or Wireframe Glow.
Highlights crates, bags, and other loot in the world.
Shows distance on loot ESP.
Shows names on loot ESP.
Shows a draggable tactical minimap overlay.
Panel and map transparency for the tactical radar overlay.
Moves the tactical map back to its default spot.
Alerts you when staff or mods join the server.
Shows the Attack Heli event NPC on ESP.
Shows Boris boss NPCs on ESP.
Shows Bruno boss NPCs on ESP.
Shows Brutus boss NPCs on ESP.
Shows the BTR event vehicle on ESP.
Shows the Diver Dave vendor NPC on ESP.
Highlights NPC soldiers, bosses, helis, and BTR.
Shows the Pilot Pete vendor NPC on ESP.
Shows military Soldier NPCs on ESP.
Shows boxes and info on other players.
Filter which players appear on ESP.
Show status flags (downed, SZ, staff, revive, movement state, VIP, cheater).
Shows the item a player is holding (same read path as Target Gear).
Marks explosion clusters as potential raids.
Toast when a raid explosion is detected.
Reloads game module offsets and caches.
Redirects shots to your locked target without moving the camera.
Which body part silent aim tracks. Randomized Part re-rolls every shot while holding Mouse 1.
Finds a shootable angle around cover. Server may reject invalid shots.
Scans the head for the closest visible point to your crosshair (manip-style math), spawns the ray on the target, and shoots through that point. Cycles offsets every frame.
Filters which targets silent aim will consider.
Chance each shot applies silent aim while holding Mouse 1. Rolls independently per shot using your gun's fire rate (not once for the whole spray).
Registers hits instantly on your locked target. Server may reject invalid shots.
Searches farther from your body when no close peek is found.
Locks onto the first valid target and stays on them until they leave your FOV or become invalid.
Choose whether silent aim targets players, NPCs, or both.
Clears the silent aim whitelist player list.
Comma-separated Roblox user IDs that Silent Aim must ignore. Enable Whitelist inside Filters first. You can also middle-click the current player target to add or remove them.
Climbs upward while you press into a nearby wall. It pulses the jump state only after multi-height wall checks, reducing wall snap-back.
Shows held weapon and gear for the player closest to your crosshair.
Independent FOV (pixels from crosshair) used only by Target Gear Overlay.
Maximum world distance (studs) for Target Gear Overlay selection.

Expands other players' head hitboxes on your client and fades them. Player ESP boxes still use natural head size so Override Size stays hidden. Helps local hit tests; the server can still reject shots that only clip the inflated shell.
How large enemy head hitboxes become (1x = normal, up to 4x). ESP boxes stay normal-sized.
Adds spin or pulse animation to the crosshair.
Extra crosshair drawing options.
Key used to open and close this menu.
Darkens the whole screen behind the menu with a smooth fade. Does not cover menu controls.
Choose which info to show on NPC ESP.
Choose which NPC types appear on ESP.
Choose which info to show on player ESP.
Choose what appears on the tactical map.
Soft falling snow behind the menu. Hidden when Reduce Motion is on.
